name: Peter Bell
caption: The fed's own on-screen president and owner, billed as "The Titan," interviewed on the Preview Show confirming the returning title slate and a PPV calendar without naming new champions.

name: Shawn Douglas
caption: Host of the fed's own Wrestle Zone news programme and the Preview Show's own interviewer of the fed's president.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; this entity was minted from its own federation's 1997 documents with no receipt joining it to those — held distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule; reopenable on a shared-handler or cross-fed receipt.

name: Matt Edwards
caption: Co-host of Tuesday Night Impact! and the Preview Show, billed face to Eric Smart's neutral/heel commentary.

name: Eric Smart
caption: Co-host of Tuesday Night Impact!, billed as the first-ever UEW Ultimate Champion taking a break from the ring for commentary.

name: Dan Watterson
caption: A wrestler arriving from the IWF/WOW, cut a debut promo on Wrestle Zone naming Rick Wright's own Main Event opponent slot the following week and needling Steve Studd.

name: "No Worries" Rob Magnum

tenures.source: Won the vacant MLW True North Championship in a Royal Rumble on 17 July 1999, then lost it 31 July 1999.
Accompanies Christian Lee onto Saturday Night Rampage, 3-4 March 2000.

caption: A seven-foot, 357-pound signee who cut a boastful debut promo on Wrestle Zone demanding a title shot and a match against Bobby Sherlock.

identity.note: Name collision only with a separately-attested wrestler under a different nickname ("Nu Warrior") in another, unrelated 1996-1998 promotion; no shared evidence beyond the bare surname.

name: Mark Knight
caption: One half of the debuting tag team Judgment Night, cutting a training-gym vignette on Wrestle Zone naming the Killing Machines as the team to beat, though the same episode's own vignette billed him 'David Knight' instead.

name: Sean Judge
caption: One half of the debuting tag team Judgment Night, cutting a training-gym vignette on Wrestle Zone vowing to bring home the tag titles.
